title: Visual Identity
shortDesc: Creating high-impact brand faces, from friendly neighborhood services to aggressive gaming-grade identities.

projects.name: Washabor Laundry Services
projects.overview: Washabor needed a brand identity that stood out in a competitive local market by moving away from generic icons and creating a friendly face for their business.
projects.details: The solution features a custom-illustrated mascot paired with bubbly, fluid typography to evoke a sense of water and cleanliness. The palette uses deep navy and bright cyan for trust, accented by a 'sunny' yellow.
projects.result: Created a distinct visual brand that works across digital social media and physical storefront signage, leading to high brand recall.

projects.name: Digibyte
projects.overview: Digibyte needed a high-impact visual identity that resonated with the gaming and high-performance PC community. They required a 'badass' brand mark that felt aggressive and modern.
projects.details: I designed a fierce T-Rex skull mascot with sharp, angular linework to represent precision and power. The deep navy and cyan gradients provide a tech-focused feel, while the glowing red eye symbolizes high-energy performance.
projects.result: A powerful, cohesive brand identity optimized for everything from large-scale shop signage to custom PC decals and social media avatars.

title: Illustration & Apparel
shortDesc: High-fidelity vector illustrations and custom apparel concepts featuring intricate character work and cultural motifs.

projects.name: Skeptron Anniversary Shirt
projects.overview: The client required a high-impact, commemorative illustration for the Alpha Kappa Rho anniversary that captured the strength and fiery spirit of the organization.
projects.details: I created a detailed dragon illustration ('Skeptron') using a vibrant five-color palette. The design focuses on aggressive linework, stippled shading for texture, and custom 'flaming' typography.
projects.result: A highly successful anniversary release that resonated with members, showcasing a professional balance between traditional symbols and modern streetwear illustration.

projects.name: Lucky Cat Custom Tee
projects.overview: A conceptual t-shirt design blending traditional Japanese 'Maneki-neko' themes with modern urban culture and vibrant color palettes.
projects.details: This vector illustration uses an arched composition featuring the 'Lucky Cat' surrounded by smoke, lanterns, and stylized clouds. The four-color palette (Red, Green, Dark Brown, Gold) provides a cohesive, premium look suitable for high-end screen printing.
projects.result: A versatile illustrative asset ready for apparel production, demonstrating high-level mastery of line weight and thematic storytelling.

projects.name: EV SUV Launch
projects.overview: A high-impact cinematic launch for a premium automotive brand's flagship electric SUV.
projects.details: Communicating 'luxury' and 'silent power' through a digital-first narrative using light, texture, and fluid motion.
projects.result: 1.2M engagement across social platforms and record-breaking pre-order inquiries.

projects.name: Quantum Reveal
projects.overview: Abstract product reveal sequence for a leading semiconductor manufacturer.
projects.details: Visualizing the invisible through advanced fluid dynamics and light-path simulations.
projects.result: Featured in 3 international motion design festivals and won 'Best of Category'.

title: Brand Strategy
shortDesc: Insight-driven roadmaps for sustainable brand growth.

projects.name: Heritage Pivot
projects.overview: Repositioning a 50-year-old heritage retail brand for the Gen-Z market.
projects.details: The brand was losing market share due to an 'out-of-touch' identity. We pivoted to 'radical transparency' and community-driven co-creation.
projects.result: 85% increase in Gen-Z audience engagement and a successful multi-city pop-up tour.

projects.name: Vision 2030 Roadmap
projects.overview: Long-term strategic narrative for a global manufacturing conglomerate.
projects.details: Defining the next decade of innovation and sustainability goals through visual storytelling and stakeholder alignment.
projects.result: Board-approved roadmap now guiding investment for 5 global business units.
